title: Advanced ChatGPT
description: Go beyond basic chat: custom GPTs, code interpreter, file analysis, and API integration for real workflows.
learningObjectives: Create custom GPTs for specific tasks
Use ChatGPT's code interpreter and file analysis

content.content: Custom GPTs let you configure ChatGPT for specific tasks with preset instructions, knowledge files, and tools. They are shareable and reusable.
Custom GPT: A configured version of ChatGPT with custom instructions, knowledge, and capabilities.
Examples: 'Legal Contract Reviewer' with contract templates, 'Code Reviewer' with style guides, 'Marketing Copywriter' with brand voice documents.
ChatGPT can execute Python code in a sandboxed environment, analyze uploaded files (CSV, Excel, PDF, images), and generate charts.
Upload a CSV of sales data → ask ChatGPT to compute totals, generate a chart, and identify trends. It runs the code and returns results.
This turns ChatGPT into a data analysis assistant, not just a text generator.
The OpenAI API lets you integrate ChatGPT into your own applications. This is how businesses build custom AI tools, chatbots, and automation.
With the API you can: process thousands of documents, build custom assistants, integrate with your app, and control costs and rate limits.
Advanced workflows combine: custom GPTs + API + automation tools (Zapier, Make) + external data sources.
